project: Eco Nojin Design System v2 — Independent QA
mode: Independent verification. Reference palette, logo options, and brand identity were NOT changed.

file_integrity.external_dependencies: NONE (no http(s) refs in html/css/js; all local)
notes: Prior report claimed 36 woff2 + fonts.css = 37 font files; confirmed 36 woff2 (36 unique).
Prior report claimed 9 SVG logos; confirmed 9.
No font license/COPYING files exist in repo; only OFL URL embedded in each font's name table.

logo_audit.structure: All 9 are SVG <text> elements. 0 contain <path>. 0 contain <symbol>/<image>/<use>.
logo_audit.outline_fidelity: Text widths match browser to ±1px for Fraunces/Manrope/DM Sans/IBM Plex Mono after instancing wght + opsz=font-size.
logo_audit.font_dependence_proof: Blocking webfonts changes logo text widths up to 16.5% (e.g. marketplace-option-03 Nojin -16.5%), proving font dependence.
logo_audit.small_size_32px_render: darkRatio 0.010–0.079; all render legibly but thin serif options (option-03s) are lightest.
logo_audit.recommendation: Owner must choose. No logo selected. Text-to-path feasible (see logo-tests).

Vazirmatn.note: weights come from one variable font; no synthesis issue

Manrope.note: all files share family 'Manrope ExtraLight' internally

IBM Plex Mono.note: static; Regular/Medium/SemiBold split across unicode-range subsets

fallbacks.font-en: Inter (NOT bundled), Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

font_audit.source_serif_4_ibm_plex_sans: NOT referenced in CSS/HTML; docs-only. Confirmed.
font_audit.license_commercial_limits: All six are SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL) — free for commercial use, may not be sold alone. No per-seat commercial license required.

contrast.residual_fails_explanation: 2 residual = the reference danger-red swatch label (#D64545, 4.38:1). This is a palette REFERENCE chip, not UI. Main label is large text (1.25rem/700) → passes 3:1; hex chip on white is 17:1. Palette value intentionally unchanged.
fixes_applied: badge/status/accent fills -> darker text-safe variants (new tokens, palette preserved)
alert text -> darker semantic text tokens
product price unit تومان -> neutral ink

keyboard.focus_order: skip-link -> theme buttons -> nav links -> theme-bar buttons -> locale buttons; hidden panels no longer tabbable

screen_reader.reason: No screen reader (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver) available in this environment. ARIA structure reviewed statically only; this is NOT equivalent to a screen-reader test.

rtl_ltr.overflow_after_fix: 0 in all three locales at all widths
rtl_ltr.font_switch: fa/ar -> Vazirmatn; en -> Inter (falls back to Segoe UI/system-ui since Inter not bundled)
rtl_ltr.note: Only 3 locales implemented; full 15-language claim is NOT made.

theme.B_tokens: Royal Deep Blue (#173B63) header, warm ivory surfaces (#FBF7F0)
theme.component_coverage: header, cards, kpi, buttons, badges, inputs, table, product-card, scientific-card all theme-aware

scientific_ui.provenance_missing_marked: NOT_AVAILABLE / NOT_GENERATED used for unknown values; no fake hashes

overall_note: QA_ACCEPTED_WITH_CORRECTIONS means the technical build is sound after fixes. It is NOT visual-identity approval. Overall design-system status remains DRAFT — NOT APPROVED.
